payload.name: Inductive ads
payload.fact: Inductive ads, which use sensor-based triggers for forced redirection, simultaneously increase perceived intrusiveness and boost brand salience.
payload.boundary: The effect on brand salience is moderated by brand familiarity, where lower brand familiarity augments the salience pathway.

provenance.title: “Annoy me, remember me”: navigating the dual effects and boundaries of inductive ads
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results indicate that while inductive ads heighten perceived intrusiveness and can lower usage intentions, they also boost brand salience, paradoxically encouraging future engagement
